name: X-face slashing criteria
definition: A set of four criteria used to decide how to slash an X-face (merge two loops) in an isosurface extraction algorithm. The slash merges two loops, decreasing the loop count for the cube by one. Depending on the situation, an X-face slash may leave the total loop count L unchanged (if one cube's count increases and the other decreases) or increase/decrease it by 2.
summary: X-face slashing criteria are four decision rules in the Cubical Marching Squares Algorithm that resolve X-face ambiguities by merging or splitting loops to control global topological invariants like loop count and shell number.
